# Swap Solana — Swap Tokens on Solana Reference

> Trade SOL, USDC and SPL tokens on the Solana network through a non-custodial DEX aggregator. Fees paid in SOL. Independent, not affiliated with Solana.

## Key Facts
- Solana: high-throughput layer-1; not EVM — uses Solana wallets like Phantom / Solflare
- Tradable assets are SPL tokens (Solana's token standard, comparable to ERC-20)
- Swaps route through on-chain DEXs, often via a DEX aggregator across liquidity pools
- Fees: network fee in SOL (low) + optional priority fee + DEX pool fee + price impact
- A new SPL token account can require a small one-time SOL rent deposit
- Custody: non-custodial — wallet signs; settlement through on-chain programs
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Solana
